ctx.x: They spelled it with a double S.

Double S. Now let me tell you how many spellings they had and you can find them. They had J-A-S J-A-S J-A-S-Z around in the 15th and we arrived in New York and we tried out two weeks. Many people think we started on the 26th or 27th. That's not right. We were there before the 7th because we didn't have no uniforms to work with and we went over to Jimmy Balletta's and Nat Levy to get tuxedos fitted up for us and make us look like gentlemen. Now we're coming out of a dive in Chicago and we're going into first class…

but that ain't the way we give it to them. We spell it J-A to bless. Well, I'm running ahead on something here. The Victor Company first spell it J-A to bless. Then they change it J-A-Z-Z. Some of the young fellas are going with girls, and they take off the J off the front, rub it off with a knife. And they say, you want to hear some good music? Look at the title of that thing. And it was a vulgar word then. It became a vulgar word. It always was a vulgar word to me because that's what I knew it is to be. And our…
